changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 17 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000856).

Withheld after the final research pass: no entrance node: the elevated platforms reach no exit at street level. The edits keep the research (platform heights, structures, entrances, amenities) for when OSM or a walk adds what's missing.
